members.name: environment

members.name: workingDirectory
members.abstract: `nil` inherits the host process's working directory.

name: TerminalView
abstract: Shows a `TerminalSession`, starting it if it is still idle. The grid fills the space the view is given; the program is told the new size whenever layout changes.
discussion:
- Keyboard and IME text go to the program; ⌘C copies the selection and ⌘V
  pastes. Other ⌘ shortcuts stay with the host.
- Drag selects (double-click a word, triple-click a line). Programs that
  ask for mouse reports receive the pointer instead; hold Shift to select.
- ⌘-click opens OSC 8 hyperlinks with `onOpenLink`, by default the system.
- Kitty graphics images are drawn in place; the cursor blinks while focused.

Default colors follow the theme's surface colors; programs can still set
their own palette.

members.name: TerminalView
members.declaration: public init(session: TerminalSession, fontSize: Float = 13, onOpenLink: ((URL) -> Void)? = nil)

name: TerminalSession
abstract: A terminal emulator bound to one program.
discussion:
Create it once (for example in `@State`) and show it with `TerminalView`,
which starts the program when it first appears. The session outlives view
updates, so recomposition never restarts the program. Like every CoveUI
model it is used from the UI thread; program output is read in the
background and applied there.

members.name: command
members.abstract: The program it runs; nil for a session that shows output it is handed.

members.name: display
members.declaration: public static func display(scrollbackLines: Int = 10_000) -> TerminalSession
members.abstract: A session that shows output it is handed instead of running a program, such as a build another process runs. Text a pipe produced, where a line ends in a bare newline, starts each line at the left margin as a terminal would.

members.name: show
members.abstract: Shows program output in a display session.

members.name: showExit
members.abstract: Ends a display session with the program's exit status.

members.name: start
members.abstract: Launches the program. `TerminalView` calls this when it first shows an idle session. A session runs one program once; create a new session to run again. Failures are also shown in the terminal itself.

members.name: send
members.abstract: Sends text as if typed, e.g. `send("ls\r")`.

members.name: paste
members.abstract: Pastes text using the program's bracketed-paste mode when enabled.

members.name: terminate
members.abstract: Hangs up the program (SIGHUP). `status` becomes `.exited` once it quits.
